1632707441984462.title: October General Meeting — Wednesday 14 October, noon, S-Aura Hotel
1632707441984462.summary: Guest speaker Shirley Lan, porcelain artist and founder of Timeless Blue Artwork Co., on “future antiques” — from clay to eternity. Free for members; guest fee applies; business casual. Register through the club's form.

1625248022730404.title: Save the date: Skål Taipei's first Halloween Party, Thu 29 October
1625248022730404.summary: 6–10 PM at WINE-derful Restaurant, hosted by Skålleague Henry. Free-flow wine, buffet and live music. NTD 2,500 +10%; families welcome.

1612896330632240.title: In memory of Past President Hiro Liao
1612896330632240.summary: Skål Taipei mourns a Past President and former Vice President of Skål East Asia — a champion of young talent and sustainable tourism, and a mentor to many.

1593086812613192.title: Honouring Steven H. Sasaya, Past President 2017–18
1593086812613192.summary: After 18 years as GM of Hotel Royal-Nikko Taipei, the hotelier who pioneered the Taiwan–Japan twinning agreement retires to Japan.

1545203484068192.title: Happy Dragon Boat Festival
